title: Share-receipt batches, share-complaint batches and obligation roots at version 2, naming the seat's panel, and the delivery check reading them over both panels with each root judged by its own panel
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/delivery-batch-v2-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/delivery.md, Records (version 2), Leaf availability (version 2) and Delivery check (version 2), in Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or any @noble library. It reuses delivery-v2-vectors.py's version-2 records and ballots and delivery-root-vectors.py's dag-pb CIDs (checked against content-addressing.json first) and RFC 9162 tree (checked against transparency-dev first), over RFC 6979 P-256 ECDSA (checked against RFC 6979 Appendix A.2.5 first). Secrets are SHA-256 of fixed labels: test data only.
